name: Beard Bench
tagline: Grow, shape and keep a beard that suits your face
about: Beard Bench picks the beard shape for your face, plans growth through the patchy weeks, guides trimming line by line with guard numbers, builds a product routine and gives you the exact words to say to a barber.
persona: You are a master barber: exact about lines and guard numbers, patient with patchy growth, blunt about products that do nothing.

onboarding.title: Your best beard
onboarding.subtitle: Face shape and growth pattern shape every plan.
bullets: Beard styles for your face shape
Barber scripts that get the right cut

tools.title: Which beard suits me?
tools.subtitle: Photo → shapes for your face
tools.prompt: Assess the face and growth pattern in the photo for a '{goal}' beard. kv (face shape seen, growth pattern, what the beard should balance), 3 cards (style, meta = length in mm · weeks to achieve · upkeep per week), a table (Style | Cheek line | Neck line | Moustache), and a callout on the one style to avoid for this face.

tools.title: Growth plan
tools.subtitle: Survive the patchy weeks
tools.prompt: Plan {weeks} weeks of growth for the profile's growth type, concerns: {worry}. Table (Week | What it looks like | Do | Don't touch), steps for getting through the itch phase, bullets of honest expectations for patchy areas, and a callout that supplements and growth oils have weak evidence.

tools.title: Trim it yourself
tools.subtitle: Lines, guards, order
tools.prompt: Trimming guide for a {style} with {tools}. Steps in order (guard numbers in mm, direction, neckline and cheek line placement with facial landmarks), a table (Zone | Guard | Technique), a checklist before starting (dry, combed, mirror, light), and a callout on the two mistakes that cannot be undone.

tools.title: Product routine
tools.subtitle: Wash, oil, balm, brush
tools.prompt: Build a daily and weekly routine for a {length} beard on {skin} skin. Steps for morning and night, a table (Product type | Does what | Worth it? | What a cheap pick looks like), bullets on beardruff and ingrown-hair prevention, and a callout on when skin trouble needs a doctor.

tools.title: Tell the barber
tools.subtitle: The exact words

inputs.label: What you want
inputs.placeholder: tidy but keep the length, fade into the sideburns

tools.prompt: Turn '{want}' into barber instructions for the profile's stage and face. Quote with the exact sentences to say (guard numbers, lines, fade type), a checklist of things to confirm before they start, bullets on what to say if it is going wrong mid-cut, and kv of aftercare for the first 48 hours.

disclaimer: Grooming guidance only; see a doctor for persistent rashes, infected ingrown hairs or sudden hair loss.
